title: Pre-training interventions, ex post facto: Grafting model beliefs across checkpoints
abstract: arXiv:2610.00767v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Pre-training interventions are critical to alignment research, since beliefs formed during pre-training shape how a model generalizes from later training. One recently popular technique for such interventions is synthetic document fine-tuning (SDF), which aims to alter what the model believes. Ideally, synthetic documents would be mixed into pre- or mid-training, but every change to a pre-training corpus must be followed by a full post-training run before its effect can be measured, making iteration slow and expensive. Common practice instead applies SDF to an already post-trained model. This is known to leave artifacts and degrade capabilities, and, as we show, it makes the model treat fabricated entities unrelated to the documents as real, a failure we call reality drift. We propose grafting: train the SDF adapter on the pre-trained checkpoint, then add the learned weight update to the post-trained model, which approximates the faith

translated_title: 事后的预训练干预：跨检查点嫁接模型信念
translated_abstract: 预训练干预对对齐研究至关重要，因为模型在预训练期间形成的信念会影响其在后续训练中的泛化方式。近期流行的一种此类干预技术是合成文档微调（SDF），其目的在于改变模型的信念。理想情况下，合成文档应混入预训练或中期训练阶段，但对预训练语料库的任何改动都必须重新进行完整的后训练流程才能衡量其效果，这使得迭代过程缓慢且昂贵。常见的替代做法是将 SDF 应用于已完成后训练的模型。已知这种做法会留下伪影并降低模型能力，而且正如我们所展示的，它还会使模型将与文档无关的虚构实体当作真实存在，我们将这种失败称为“现实漂移”。我们提出嫁接方法：在预训练检查点上训练 SDF 适配器，然后将学习到的权重更新叠加到后训练模型上，这近似于……（摘要至此被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“嫁接”方法，在预训练检查点上训练合成文档微调适配器，再将学到的权重更新移植到后训练模型，从而实现快速廉价的事后预训练干预，同时避免了直接在后训练模型上应用SDF所带来的伪影、能力退化和“现实漂移”问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes "grafting"—training the SDF adapter on the pre-trained checkpoint and adding the learned weight update to the post-trained model—enabling fast, low-cost post-hoc pre-training interventions while avoiding the artifacts, capability degradation, and "reality drift" caused by applying SDF directly to post-trained models.
